note: ADR 1058: a helper that returns a fresh object literal holding its parameter (`function boxed(cb) { return { cb } }`) boxes the caller's function, so `const box = boxed(() => …); box.cb()` runs it in the component body: the static `dynamic` promise (DYNAMIC_STATIC_PROMISE) throws there and the page reports it (violations at BoxedCalled and KeyedCalled). A helper that also stores, two returns, a spread, a box handed on or written, and an imported helper stay uncertifiable; nothing at the caught call. A closed literal or a box called through a hoisted declaration before its declarator throws a ReferenceError there, not the promise: no violation (ADR 1059's review).
